hooks.name: Astro component quality checklist
hooks.description: When a component .astro file is saved, reminds the agent to verify the quality checklist before marking the component done.

action.prompt: A component .astro file was just saved. Before marking it done, verify these non-negotiable rules from `references/astro-standards.md`: - **No `set:html` on unsanitized content** — use `` or the official renderer for Tina rich-text fields, never raw `set:html`. - **No inline `style="..."` attributes** for values that repeat — use CSS custom properties or scoped `
